incomparable: C0 8-cell symbol observations only; the S1 arena payloads (relative_objects/ego_motion) are not its registered input
no metric map, no episodic topology memory, no pose estimate head
S1 metrics are reported as not_applicable; its own C0 M2 diagnostics are the only comparable row and are flagged incomparable
arm1.name: D candidate re-verification (evaluate only)

arm4.name: equivariant metric map + episodic topology graph

commands.run_refused_here: ainerzero s1-phase1 --mode train --prereg reports/V9-P9/pre_registration.json (refused until the coordinator approves the frozen file)

plan.restricted_exit: awz.V9.B1 r3 conventions (HandleAllocator + CounterNoise + A3 validator)

effective_metadata.equivariant_source: analytic normalisation (G3 estimated pose + covariance-injected error); truth-pose normalisation is upper-bound diagnostic only and is never scored
effective_metadata.final_partition: sealed; read-once only after all phase-1 training by the evaluator card; S1 phase 1 (and this preregistration card) never reads it
effective_metadata.forbidden: multi-step rollout, Muon, equivariant-network/no-equivariance arms, E1 physics prior: all reserved for phase 2

metrics.definition: per-step agent pose estimate error against evaluator truth pose; mean and median translation error (m) and yaw error (deg); loop-closure segment reported separately
localization error and next-observation NLL on development worlds (never seen in training); final partition is read-once only after all training and is out of scope for this card

edge precision/recall of the arm's place graph against the true free-space adjacency graph restricted to visited cells; reported for confounded observations (shared appearance classes, handle reissue after occlusion)

write k in {0,1,2,4,8} support transitions of a development world into memory without parameter updates, then predict held-out transitions (edge existence and destination displacement); accuracy and displacement error vs k
development localization error and next-observation NLL at the frozen update checkpoints; one curve per arm x seed
zero-state vs history-paired probe and retention delta after writing a new world's memories without parameter updates; report with the D candidate row, incomparable items flagged

phase: S1 phase 1 (structured restricted observation arms; no visual-teacher arm)

resource_limit_sources.mlx_memory_gib: pilot resource profile / registered run protection
resource_limit_sources.process_memory_gib: pilot resource profile / registered run protection
resource_limit_sources.training_duty_cycle: registered duty cycle for S1 phase 1

source_identity.repo_worktree_note: working tree may carry other cards' changes; the prereg binds the files above, the data source map and the A2 baseline manifest, not the whole tree

stop_rules: non-finite loss, gradient or parameter aborts this run as failed
exceeding the frozen per-run deadline aborts this run as failed
exceeding the process memory line (8 GiB, RSS) aborts this run as failed
exceeding the MLX memory line (4 GiB) aborts this run as failed
exceeding the 16 GiB system reserve line aborts and marks the run failed
same-boot swap growth above 1 GiB aborts this run as failed
no rerun and no borrowing across seeds; a failed run stays failed
any run outside the frozen preregistration needs a new coordinator registration

timing.rule: deadline = ceil(1.25 * measured_estimate); supervision = deadline + 50 s; per-run wall <= 20 min; phase-1 total wall <= 4 h

training_protocol.objective: one-step observation prediction (self-supervised) + geometric pose consistency
training_protocol.update_rule: updates = floor(((target_estimate * duty / overhead) - eval_cost) / (update_cost_factor * measured_forward_loss_step_seconds)), clamped to [updates_min, updates_cap]; shrink until the frozen deadline fits the per-run cap
